CREATE TRIGGER lambings_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON lambings BEGIN
  INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id,
                           title, body, occurred_at)
  VALUES ('lambing', new.id, new.ewe, new.season,
          (SELECT e.tag FROM ewes e WHERE e.id = new.ewe) || ' ' || new.local_date,
          COALESCE(new.note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.presentation_note, '')
            || ' ' || COALESCE(new.assisted_by, ''),
          new.occurred_at);
END;

CREATE TRIGGER lambings_search_au
AFTER UPDATE OF note, presentation_note, assisted_by, local_date ON lambings BEGIN
  UPDATE search_docs
     SET title = (SELECT e.tag FROM ewes e WHERE e.id = new.ewe) || ' ' || new.local_date,
         body = COALESCE(new.note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.presentation_note, '')
                  || ' ' || COALESCE(new.assisted_by, '')
   WHERE subject_kind = 'lambing' AND subject_id = new.id;
END;

data.sql: CREATE VIEW lambing_consistency AS SELECT l.id AS lambing_id, l.declared_birth_type AS declared, COUNT(lb.id) AS recorded,(l.declared_birth_type IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(lb.id) <> l.declared_birth_type AND NOT(l.declared_birth_type = 5 AND COUNT(lb.id) >= 5))AS is_mismatched FROM lambings AS l LEFT JOIN lambs AS lb ON lb.lambing = l.id GROUP BY l.id

data.name: lamb_rearing
data.sql: CREATE VIEW lamb_rearing AS SELECT lb.id AS lamb_id, lb.birth_dam AS birth_dam, COALESCE((SELECT fe.rearing_dam FROM foster_events AS fe WHERE fe.lamb = lb.id ORDER BY fe.effective_at DESC, fe.id DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foster_events AS fe2 WHERE fe2.lamb = lb.id) THEN NULL ELSE lb.birth_dam END) AS rearing_dam, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foster_events AS fe3 WHERE fe3.lamb = lb.id) AS was_fostered FROM lambs AS lb

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_docs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "subject_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ewe_id" INTEGER, "season_id" INTEGER, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(subject_kind, subject_id)) STRICT;
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_fts" USING fts5(title, body, content='search_docs', content_rowid='id', tokenize='porter unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER search_docs_ai AFTER INSERT ON search_docs BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts ("rowid", title, body) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.body);END
CREATE TRIGGER search_docs_ad AFTER DELETE ON search_docs BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (search_fts, "rowid", title, body) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.body);END

CREATE TRIGGER search_docs_au AFTER UPDATE ON search_docs BEGIN INSERT INTO search_fts (search_fts, "rowid", title, body) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.body);INSERT INTO search_fts ("rowid", title, body) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.body);END

CREATE TRIGGER notes_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes BEGIN INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id, title, body, occurred_at) VALUES ('note', new.id, new.ewe, new.season, 'note', COALESCE(new.body, ''), new.occurred_at);END
CREATE TRIGGER notes_search_au AFTER UPDATE OF body ON notes BEGIN UPDATE search_docs SET body = COALESCE(new.body, '') WHERE subject_kind = 'note' AND subject_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER notes_search_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes BEGIN DELETE FROM search_docs WHERE subject_kind = 'note' AND subject_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER ewes_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON ewes BEGIN INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id, title, body, occurred_at) VALUES ('ewe', new.id, new.id, NULL, new.tag, COALESCE(new.notes, ''), new.created_at);END
CREATE TRIGGER ewes_search_au AFTER UPDATE OF tag, notes ON ewes BEGIN UPDATE search_docs SET title = new.tag, body = COALESCE(new.notes, '') WHERE subject_kind = 'ewe' AND subject_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER ewes_search_ad AFTER DELETE ON ewes BEGIN DELETE FROM search_docs WHERE subject_kind = 'ewe' AND subject_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER lambings_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON lambings BEGIN INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id, title, body, occurred_at) VALUES ('lambing', new.id, new.ewe, new.season, (SELECT e.tag FROM ewes AS e WHERE e.id = new.ewe) || ' ' || new.local_date, COALESCE(new.note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.presentation_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.assisted_by, ''), new.occurred_at);END

CREATE TRIGGER lambings_search_au AFTER UPDATE OF note, presentation_note, assisted_by, local_date ON lambings BEGIN UPDATE search_docs SET title = (SELECT e.tag FROM ewes AS e WHERE e.id = new.ewe) || ' ' || new.local_date, body = COALESCE(new.note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.presentation_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.assisted_by, '') WHERE subject_kind = 'lambing' AND subject_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER lambings_search_ad AFTER DELETE ON lambings BEGIN DELETE FROM search_docs WHERE subject_kind = 'lambing' AND subject_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER lambs_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON lambs BEGIN INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id, title, body, occurred_at) VALUES ('lamb', new.id, new.birth_dam, (SELECT l.season FROM lambings AS l WHERE l.id = new.lambing), COALESCE(new.tag, ''), COALESCE(new.notes, ''), new.created_at);END

CREATE TRIGGER lambs_search_au AFTER UPDATE OF tag, notes ON lambs BEGIN UPDATE search_docs SET title = COALESCE(new.tag, ''), body = COALESCE(new.notes, '') WHERE subject_kind = 'lamb' AND subject_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER lambs_search_ad AFTER DELETE ON lambs BEGIN DELETE FROM search_docs WHERE subject_kind = 'lamb' AND subject_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER treatments_search_ai AFTER INSERT ON treatments BEGIN INSERT INTO search_docs (subject_kind, subject_id, ewe_id, season_id, title, body, occurred_at) VALUES ('treatment', new.id, new.ewe, new.season, new.product_name, COALESCE(new.dose_text, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.batch_no, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.note, ''), new.administered_at);END

CREATE TRIGGER treatments_search_au AFTER UPDATE OF product_name, dose_text, batch_no, note ON treatments BEGIN UPDATE search_docs SET title = new.product_name, body = COALESCE(new.dose_text, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.batch_no, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(new.note, '') WHERE subject_kind = 'treatment' AND subject_id = new.id;END
CREATE TRIGGER treatments_search_ad AFTER DELETE ON treatments BEGIN DELETE FROM search_docs WHERE subject_kind = 'treatment' AND subject_id = old.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER lamb_birth_dam_is_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF birth_dam ON lambs WHEN old.birth_dam IS NOT new.birth_dam BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'birth_dam is immutable; record a foster instead');END

CREATE VIEW lambing_consistency AS SELECT l.id AS lambing_id, l.declared_birth_type AS declared, COUNT(lb.id) AS recorded,(l.declared_birth_type IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(lb.id) <> l.declared_birth_type AND NOT(l.declared_birth_type = 5 AND COUNT(lb.id) >= 5))AS is_mismatched FROM lambings AS l LEFT JOIN lambs AS lb ON lb.lambing = l.id GROUP BY l.id

CREATE VIEW lamb_rearing AS SELECT lb.id AS lamb_id, lb.birth_dam AS birth_dam, COALESCE((SELECT fe.rearing_dam FROM foster_events AS fe WHERE fe.lamb = lb.id ORDER BY fe.effective_at DESC, fe.id DESC LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foster_events AS fe2 WHERE fe2.lamb = lb.id) THEN NULL ELSE lb.birth_dam END) AS rearing_dam, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM foster_events AS fe3 WHERE fe3.lamb = lb.id) AS was_fostered FROM lambs AS lb
